the flavonoid-rich Citrus sinensis extract is able to reduce the body weight of obese zebrafishes and restore some of the metabolic alterations induced by a high-fat diet, thus suggesting a role of this extract in weight management.

the flavonoid-rich orange juice extract (OJe), when added to the diet of diet-induced obese zebra fish, reduced their body weight, body mass index, and visceral adipose tissue and lowered their adipocyte cell size, both in the visceral and subcutanic adipose tissue, and reduced adipocyte number in the visceral adipose depot.

a flavonoid extract from orange juice is able to counteract diet-induced obesity in zebrafish by modulating both adipocyte cell size and number and the expression of genes involved in the metabolism-regulating network.
